summary: Completed comprehensive end-to-end frontend testing of TrustPause 2.0 Ambient Human Firewall app. All 4 scenarios (SMS Phishing, UPI Transfer, Digital Arrest Call, Deepfake Voice) tested successfully with all interaction paths verified. View toggle, reset, architecture drawer, mute cues, responsiveness, and stability all working correctly.
passed_tests: App loads with no console errors, dark theme applied correctly
Header elements: title 'TrustPause 2.0', subtitle 'Ambient Human Firewall', live risk gauge, status chip, view toggle, mute toggle, reset button all present
All 4 scenario tabs (KYC Phishing, UPI Transfer, Digital Arrest, Deepfake Voice) switch instantly and render correct scenarios
SMS Phishing: Link click triggers intervention modal with 10s countdown that decreases correctly
SMS Phishing: Domain mismatch section shows hdfc-secure-verify.example vs hdfcbank.com
SMS Phishing: 'Open anyway' button correctly DISABLED during countdown and ENABLED after countdown completes
SMS Phishing: Safe CTA closes modal, shows safe outcome card, risk drops to 8 (safe band)
SMS Phishing: Report button shows reported outcome card, risk drops to 6
SMS Phishing: Override (after countdown) shows overridden outcome card, risk rises to 92 (danger band)
UPI Transfer: Amount shows ₹18,000, payee shows rahul.kmr9284@okaxis
UPI Transfer: Pay Now triggers Action Lock overlay, risk rises to 88 (danger band)
UPI Transfer: Press & hold for 1.5s then release correctly resets progress to 0% (override not completed)
UPI Transfer: Press & hold for 3+ seconds completes override, shows overridden outcome, risk rises to 96
UPI Transfer: Call Saved Contact shows verify outcome, risk drops to 14 (safe)
UPI Transfer: Cancel Payment shows cancelled outcome, risk drops to 6 (safe)
Digital Arrest: Start call shows incoming call card with caller name 'CBI Cyber Crime Branch'
Digital Arrest: Call risk card appears after ~1s with unverified VoIP and secrecy markers
Digital Arrest: End Call & Report shows ended outcome, risk drops to 5 (safe)
Digital Arrest: Verify Helpline shows verified outcome, risk drops to 12 (safe)
Digital Arrest: Answer call shows transcript progressively, risk rises to 95 (danger)
Deepfake Voice: Audio card present with waveform, play toggle starts playback (data-playing=true)
Deepfake Voice: Risk factors reveal progressively (urgency +15, fear +20, secrecy +20, synthetic +30)
Deepfake Voice: Cognitive risk total correctly ends at 85/100
Deepfake Voice: Intervention banner appears when risk >= 70
Deepfake Voice: Verify Code Word shows verified outcome, risk drops to 12
Deepfake Voice: Block & Report shows blocked outcome, risk drops to 8
View toggle: Desktop and Phone modes switch correctly
Phone Frame: Wraps scenario with notch/status bar, all interactions work inside frame
Reset Simulation: Clears event timeline, clears signals (count=0), resets risk to baseline, restores scenario to initial state
Telemetry Panel: Shows detected signals with count, decision timeline logs events
Architecture Drawer: Toggle expands/collapses drawer
Architecture Drawer: Shows 4 cards (call-screening, accessibility, link-handling, ios-hooks)
Architecture Drawer: Privacy callout present mentioning no 24/7 background screen recording
Mute Cues Toggle: Toggles aria-pressed state, app does not crash with cues muted
Responsiveness (1024x768): No horizontal overflow, header controls wrap, tabs tappable
Responsiveness (390x844): No horizontal overflow, intervention modal readable/scrollable on mobile
Stability: Repeated scenario runs work correctly, no stuck timers, no duplicate overlays, no console errors
